# Flightdeck

> Flightdeck is a self-hosted observability and control plane for production and coding agents. Every LLM call, MCP event and tool call an agent makes streams to a per-agent timeline and a live fleet-wide feed. Operators set token budgets, MCP server allow/block rules and live directives on production agents (the Claude Code plugin enforces the MCP rules only). Apache 2.0.

Production agents add the `flightdeck-sensor` Python package (`pip install flightdeck-sensor`, then `init()` and `patch()` in the entrypoint); it intercepts the Anthropic, OpenAI and litellm SDKs and the frameworks built on them (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI), and the official `mcp` client SDK, with no other code changes. Coding agents attach through the Claude Code plugin in the same repository (`/plugin marketplace add flightdeckhq/flightdeck`, then `/plugin install flightdeck@flightdeck-plugins`). Flightdeck is one `flightdeck` binary (the ingestion API, the workers, the query API, the message bus and the dashboard in one process) on SQLite by default, Postgres as an option. It installs with one command per platform (`curl -fsSL https://flightdeck-hq.com/install.sh | sh` on Linux and macOS, `irm https://flightdeck-hq.com/install.ps1 | iex` in PowerShell on Windows), then runs as `flightdeck`; Homebrew, `pip install flightdeck-cli` and the `flightdeckhq/flightdeck` Docker image install the same binary. The same image runs under Docker Compose, and a Helm chart deploys the control plane on Kubernetes.

Flightdeck is not a proxy or LLM gateway (calls go straight to the provider), not multi-tenant SaaS, and does not store prompt content from production agents unless capture is turned on (the Python sensor defaults to `capture_prompts=False`). The Claude Code plugin captures prompts and sanitised tool inputs by default, since you are observing your own session; `FLIGHTDECK_CAPTURE_PROMPTS=false` turns that off.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/flightdeckhq/flightdeck/blob/main/README.md): install, connecting agents, what you get, coverage in short, self-hosting in short
- [Coverage](https://github.com/flightdeckhq/flightdeck/blob/main/guides/coverage.md): every intercepted LLM SDK method, the framework matrices, coding agents, sub-agents, MCP, what is not planned
- [Features](https://github.com/flightdeckhq/flightdeck/blob/main/guides/features.md): each dashboard page and control in full
- [Self-hosting](https://github.com/flightdeckhq/flightdeck/blob/main/guides/self-hosting.md): Docker Compose, the Helm chart and its values, upgrade notes, backups
- [OpenTelemetry into Flightdeck](https://github.com/flightdeckhq/flightdeck/blob/main/guides/opentelemetry.md): Claude Code's own telemetry and the agent frameworks' GenAI spans
- [MCP Protection Policy](https://github.com/flightdeckhq/flightdeck/blob/main/guides/mcp-protection-policy.md): scopes, resolution, configuration and enforcement
- [Architecture](https://github.com/flightdeckhq/flightdeck/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): components, event types and payloads, APIs, analytics, content capture
- [Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/flightdeckhq/flightdeck/blob/main/plugin/README.md): what the plugin reports for each hook, configuration, privacy
- [Python sensor](https://github.com/flightdeckhq/flightdeck/blob/main/sensor/README.md): the `flightdeck-sensor` package, identity, `patch()` vs `wrap()`, environment variables, limitations
